MR1622-ZZ is a dimension-matched offer, not established original MPN. ET2216 without suffix is explicitly open in SMB catalog; alias lists cannot erase closure/material/clearance differences.

identity_questions: Photograph both bearing faces and packaging, read manufacturer/full suffix/lot; measure actual removed bore/OD/width. Mesh envelope is not specimen metrology.
Confirm open versus one/two shields or seals, steel grade, cage, lubricant, radial clearance, tolerance class and installed running torque. Do not assume ABEC equivalence or upgrade.
Reconcile real hardware count and all retainers/spacers/fasteners with MJCF visual count; mesh count is not a complete service BOM.
Request separate11/1100/11000 and3/300/3000piece quotations; include MOQ, pack rounding, stock date, traceability, sample inspection and destination-dependent freight/tax. No order commitment.
